hints.title: Feedback Word Scoring
hints.text: Each positive feedback word contributes +3 points, and each negative feedback word subtracts 1 point.

hints.title: Fast Word Lookup
hints.text: Place positive and negative keywords into sets for constant time membership checks per word.

hints.title: Score Evaluation and Tie-Breaking
hints.text: Sort students primarily by descending points, and break ties by ascending student_id.

hints.title: Student Feedback Ranking Implementation

complexity.notes: Hash set membership test for each word followed by sorting scores.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Repeatedly searching keyword lists without sets takes O(W * (P + N)).
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(P + N) memory to store keyword sets.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Uses sets for O(1) keyword classification and implements the multi-attribute sorting criteria.
